input.brief: Biomedical aesthetics studio in Lavras-MG: exosome regeneration, laser tattoo removal, brow micropigmentation, RegenereHair, professional courses; owner Amanda Teixeira

direction.name: Photographs at uneven sizes
direction.idea: A calm page where the pictures are placed like prints on a gallery wall: each at its own size and position, with text set small and light between them. Nothing lines up in the obvious way, yet everything sits on a grid you can feel. The unevenness is what makes it read as art-directed by a person: a small portrait far left, a wide landscape running off the right edge, a square that overlaps the next section. It lets photographs lead without ever becoming a slideshow.
direction.composition: A 12-column grid with wide margins (5–7vw). The hero is a single line of large light type (6–9vw) across the top third, and below it one photograph placed off-centre (columns 6–12, 16:10), its top edge overlapping the baseline zone of the headline by a few pixels of deliberate tension. Each following section places two or three photographs with different spans and vertical offsets: for example a 3:4 portrait in columns 2–5 starting 120px lower than a 16:10 landscape in columns 7–12; then a single small 1:1 in columns 9–11 beside a paragraph in columns 2–6. Paragraphs are short (max 40ch) and sit in the gaps. No two consecutive sections use the same arrangement. Vertical spacing is large and irregular on purpose (120–260px).
direction.typography: A light or regular weight at large size for the few headings; small, quiet text. Serif or a slender sans. Everything left-aligned to grid lines.
direction.colour: A pale neutral ground with one deep ink taken from the photographs. No accent beyond a quiet link colour.
direction.imagery: Six to nine photographs from one set, in a deliberate mix of ratios (3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 16:10, 21:9). Square corners. Captions, if any, are one short line under an image in the soft ink.
direction.richness: Placement. The differing sizes and offsets create movement on a still page.
direction.pitfalls: Uneven is not random: every image edge lands on a column line, and offsets come from a small set of values. On a phone, keep the unevenness with alternating widths (100%, 72% left, 60% right) rather than stacking everything full width.

hero.name: Small name, open sky
hero.blueprint: A single photograph fills the viewport edge to edge with no frame: choose one whose upper 45% is sky, wall or water with nothing in it and whose subject sits low and off-centre. All type is white and stays out of that empty zone. Top-left at a 24px margin, the name is stacked on two or three lines at 14px, like a letterhead. Top-right, three or four text links run in one line at 14px separated by commas, the current one marked by a 2px underline. Bottom-left, 32px from the left and bottom edges, the name repeats as the only larger type: two tight lines at clamp(44px, 4.2vw, 64px), line-height 1.0, regular weight, on columns 1–5. On the same baseline at the bottom-right margin sits the single action as an underlined text link with an arrow, and above it one supporting sentence at 15px, right-aligned, max 32ch. If a lower corner is too bright for white type, darken that corner alone with a neutral scrim. The page below opens on plain paper with one narrow paragraph and wide empty margins.
hero.mobile: The photograph is cropped to portrait around its subject and fills 100svh, its upper half still empty. The small stacked name stays top-left at 13px and the links collapse to one word top-right. The larger name sits bottom-left at 9.5vw on two lines, 20px in. The supporting sentence and the underlined action stack beneath it at 15px, left-aligned, 24px above the bottom edge.
hero.headline: The name set small on two lines of up to about 16 characters each at 4.2vw; the photograph does the work of a headline.

photos.alt: Leopard walking along a sandy dirt road beside grass
Shaggy highland cow standing on a sandy hillside
Black labrador puppy looking up from a wooden floor
Seagull standing on a ledge against a pale blue sea
Deer silhouettes grazing in a golden misty meadow

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Pinned title, portraits pass
sections.blueprint: A wrapper tall enough for its portraits: about 90svh per person, up to six people. A `position: sticky; top: 0` layer of 100svh holds the heading, two words at clamp(88px, 12vw, 180px), leading 0.85, centred at mid-height, in white with `mix-blend-mode: difference` so it reads over ground and photographs alike. Beneath it in the stacking order, portraits scroll past in normal flow: each a 4:5 photograph 26–30vw wide, alternately starting at column 2 and ending at column 11, 60svh apart, so each one passes behind a different half of the heading. Under each portrait's left corner: the name at 18px, the role at 14px in the soft ink, and one sentence of up to 30 words in a 280px measure. The last portrait is followed by 40svh of empty ground before the heading releases. Square corners. Nothing else is on screen.
sections.mobile: The heading shrinks to 17vw and pins 16px from the top instead of at mid-height. Portraits become 72% wide, alternating between the left and right margins, 48px apart, each with name, role and sentence beneath at the portrait's width.

sections.name: Statement, table pushed right
sections.blueprint: A heading of four to six words spans the full width on two lines at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), left-aligned with its first line indented 3vw and leading 0.98. 96px below, the table is pushed into the right-hand five columns (8–12) and the left stays open. One plain word naming the table (offices, hours, rates) hangs at 14px in column 7, top-aligned with the first row. Each row is a three-part line at 15–16px with 26px between rows: the kind or day in the soft ink at the left of the measure, the place or service at 30%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. In columns 1–4, bottom-aligned with the last row, one 4:5 photograph 22vw wide may sit alone. Holds 5–14 rows.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9.5vw without the indent. The table takes the full width at 16px; each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line. The naming word is dropped because the heading already says it. The photograph follows at 60% width on the right margin.

sections.name: Band of unequal panels
sections.blueprint: A modest heading, then one wide band of pictures. The heading, two to four words at 36–44px, starts at column 3, left of centre, with 64px beneath it. The band spans the full viewport width edge to edge and is 68svh tall: four photographs standing side by side with no gaps and deliberately unequal widths, a flex row with flex-grow values of 5, 2, 3 and 2. Each panel is cropped with object-fit: cover to a tall slice, so the band reads as one folded view. The first panel carries a two-line title at 28px in paper colour at its top-left, 24px in, over a neutral scrim that covers only that corner. Hovering a panel raises its flex-grow to 6 over 500ms while the others give way; without hover the widths simply stay. One caption line at 16px sits under the band at the left margin.
sections.mobile: The heading sits on the margin at 28px. The band becomes a two-by-two block with no gaps, 84svh tall in total: the first row split 64/36 and the second 36/64, so the slices stay unequal. The title stays on the first panel. No hover behaviour.

sections.name: Photographs gathered round a heading
sections.blueprint: A band about one screen tall on the plain page ground, used as the page's one deliberate rest. At its visual centre sits the heading, two lines at clamp(32px, 2.6vw, 40px) in a light weight, centred, with one sentence at 17px under it and a text link beneath that. Around it six to eight small photographs are scattered irregularly across the middle columns (x 320–1120; the outer 320px on each side stay empty, equally), each 160–200px wide at about 9:10, square corners, at different heights with 60–200px of air between them. Two of them come within 40px of the heading's block, which their drift never reaches, so the cluster reads as gathered round it rather than laid on a grid. No captions and no frames. Each photograph drifts at its own rate as the band passes (4–12% of its own height on a scroll-linked timeline), so the cluster loosens and tightens; under reduced motion it stays put. The pictures come from one place or one day and share one treatment.
sections.mobile: Five photographs at 30% of the width sit offset left and right around the centred heading, two above it and three below, none cut by an edge. The heading drops to 7vw on two lines.

sections.name: Staggered tiles, empty cells
sections.blueprint: A four-column grid with 16px gutters and 5vw margins in which tiles snap to columns but vary in span and height, and some cells are deliberately left empty. Pattern for eight projects: row one, a wide tile spanning columns 1–2 at 3:2 and a single tile in column 4 at 4:5, column 3 empty; row two, single tiles in columns 2 and 3, columns 1 and 4 empty; row three, a wide tile in columns 3–4 and a single in column 1. Each tile is a photograph, or a project image centred with 12% padding on a flat pastel or dark ground from the palette. Square corners, or one consistent shape detail such as a large radius on the bottom-right corner only. Under each tile one caption row at 14px: project name left, year and category right. The heading, two words stacked at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), occupies the empty cell of row one.
sections.mobile: Two columns with 10px gutters. Wide tiles span both columns; single tiles alternate left and right with the other cell left empty beside every second one, so the stagger survives. The heading sits above at 10vw. Captions stack the name over the year.

sections.name: Questions beside a tall photograph
sections.blueprint: One field in a deep or pale flat tone, split 5 to 7. Left, columns 1–5: a heading of two to four words at 36–44px; under it the three or four practical facts people ask first (address, times, how to arrive) as plain lines at 18px; then five or six questions as an accordion with no lines between rows, only 28px of space. Each question is a `<summary>` at 20px with a small chevron drawn from two 2px strokes at its right; the open answer sits beneath at 17px in the softer ink, on the same left edge. One filled button and one text link close the column. Right, columns 7–12: a tall photograph (3:4) that bleeds off the top edge of the section and stops 80px short of the bottom, with a second, square photograph a third of its width overlapping its lower-left corner by 40px.
sections.mobile: The tall photograph leads at full width, 4:5, with the square one overlapping its bottom-right corner at 38% width. Heading at 30px, facts at 17px, then the accordion at full width with 24px between questions and 44px touch targets. Button full width at the end.

sections.name: Sentence, portrait, two links
sections.blueprint: One closing row of three elements hanging from the same top line, with open ground between them, on a 12-column grid. Columns 1–5: a sentence of 12–18 words at clamp(26px, 3vw, 44px), four lines, leading 1.1, saying what kind of enquiries are welcome; it is set as a paragraph and there is no separate heading. Columns 8–9: one small square portrait or photograph of the place, 150–170px, with square corners. Columns 10–12: a short question at 18px in medium weight, then 20px below it two underlined links stacked at 18px (the email address and one booking or social link), and beneath them a line at 14px in the soft ink with the city and the usual reply time. Columns 6–7 stay empty. The row has 160px of space above and 120px below. No form. On a dark ground the photograph is the only bright thing in the row.
sections.mobile: The sentence comes first at 7.4vw. Below it the portrait at 96px square sits at the left margin with the question and the two links to its right, top-aligned, in the remaining width. The city and reply-time line spans the full width beneath.

sections.name: Name first, places under it
sections.blueprint: The wordmark opens the footer instead of closing it. On a full-bleed field in the page's inverse or final chapter colour, the name spans the full content width as the first thing, its cap line pushed 8% above the footer's top edge so the tops of the letters are sliced off by the section (`overflow: hidden` and a negative top margin in `em`). 72px beneath, a two-part row: columns 1–5 list the places or ways to reach the studio (cities, or email and telephone), one per line at 32–36px in the accent ink, each a link; columns 7–12 hold three columns of small links at 15px, top-aligned with the first place. A final row 96px lower carries the legal line at the left and a back-to-top text link at the right, both 13px. The field is about 90svh tall, and nothing sits between the wordmark and the row but space.
sections.mobile: The sliced wordmark stays at the top, fitted to the width. Places follow as a list at 26px, then the link columns two across at 15px. Legal line and back-to-top link share the last row at 12px, at opposite margins.

references.name: Zara Webb
references.idea: A one-woman newborn-care practice presented like a hand-made keepsake: a mascot rabbit, scalloped and flower-shaped cut-outs, candid film photographs.
references.hero: Split exactly in half. Left, on cream: two-line mono caps nav stacks sit at the column's top-left and top-right with a handwritten script logo centred between them. Centred below, a five-line headline in a condensed serif, each line broken to one to three words so the block forms a ragged lozenge; then a three-line 16px sans paragraph and an outlined pill button in mono caps. A line-drawn rabbit on a skateboard rides a hairline at the column's bottom-right. Right: a candid flash photograph bleeds off the top and right edges and stops at 92% height; a lilac pill button and a round chat icon overlay its top-right corner.
references.type: Instrument Serif Regular for headings (52 to 57px, plus a 9.4vw footer wordmark), its italic for subheads and service names; Inter Tight for small body copy; PT Mono uppercase for nav, buttons and tiny captions; a script logo. Parenthesised italic numerals number the services.
references.colour: #fffdf1 #403630 #ece4d2 #e2c9f7 #cfe195 #f6e7e4 — Warm cream page with cocoa-brown text and two brown panels. Lilac marks the main pill button and footer wordmark; a sage-green pill marks a secondary action. Warm throughout.
references.imagery: Candid flash and film photos of babies and carers, some grainy black-and-white, cropped into non-rectangular masks (four-petal flower, scalloped egg) or small rounded portraits; plus black line doodles with halftone-dot fills: a recurring rabbit, flowers, a rattle, a bottle.
references.layout: 20px margins. Centred serif statements with small centred paragraphs alternate with split or inset blocks: a brown rounded panel, a half-photo half-beige block. Services run as a two-column hairline list. Doodles are tucked beside headlines; the footer's top edge is scalloped.

sections.description: A dark brown panel with about 11px radius, inset 20px from the page. Left half: a three-line cream serif statement at about 56px and below it a photograph masked into a four-lobed flower about 540px across, cropped by the panel's bottom, with two tiny mono captions floating beside its lobes. Right, from 63%: two blocks, each an italic serif subhead over a four-line small paragraph, then two flower doodles, a caps line and a lilac pill button.

A centred two-line serif heading and a four-line centred paragraph. Below, a two-column list inset to the middle 72% of the width; each item opens with a hairline, then a parenthesised italic numeral, the service name in italic serif at about 32px and a three-line small description. Rows are tall with generous empty space; the final cell swaps to a faded question prompt with the rabbit doodle.

A half-and-half block. Left: a grainy black-and-white extreme close-up of a baby's eye and cheek, full-bleed, overlapped from the bottom by a cream cut-out shaped like an egg with a scalloped top; it holds an italic serif subhead, a five-line centred paragraph, a caps line and a sage pill button. Right: a flat beige field with a centred two-line serif heading and a small rounded portrait about 230px wide flanked by two tiny mono captions.

Dark brown, its top edge cut into a row of twelve semicircular scallops about 120px wide. A centred three-line serif statement in cream with bottle and flower doodles at its shoulders and a waving rabbit beneath; two small centred text blocks at far left and right; contact lines and four social icons; then the name in lilac serif at 9.4vw, cropped by the bottom edge, with tiny mono legal text in both corners.

steal: Mask photographs into soft custom shapes (a four-petal flower, a scalloped egg) and let their container crop them.
Cut a section's top edge into a row of semicircles so a plain colour change becomes a motif.
Break a centred serif headline into very short lines so it forms a deliberate ragged shape, and anchor it with one small line drawing sitting on a hairline.

references.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
references.idea: Let the renders do the talking: one full-bleed visualisation, a name set half in grotesk and half in serif, then alternating oversized sans and serif statements on white.
references.hero: A single architectural render fills the viewport edge to edge: a low grey metal-clad building under a large overcast sky, wild grass across the bottom third. Type is white and tiny except for the name. Top-left at a 24px margin, the bureau name is stacked on three lines at 13px. Top-right, four links run inline separated by commas, the current one underlined. Bottom-left, the name repeats at 60px (4.2vw) on two tight lines, the first two words in grotesk and the last word in a serif at the same size. No button, no scrim, no tagline; the sky takes the upper 45% untouched.
references.type: Two faces (digest names are obfuscated): a tight neo-grotesk at −0.03em and a soft high-contrast serif, mixed inside one line in the name. Section statements alternate: centred sans at about 6.5vw, then left-aligned serif at 4.5vw with a first-line indent. Labels are 9px.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #b7b7b9 #7c8050 #3d3a36 #9a9a9a — White pages with black type; colour comes only from the renders' overcast greys, greens and dark timber. The footer inverts to solid black with white letters.
references.imagery: Photoreal architectural visualisations in muted natural light, shown full-bleed at wide panoramic crops with square corners and no overlays; one loose black ink sketch on white stands in for process.
references.layout: 24px outer margins. Full-bleed image bands alternate with white type-only screens. Big statements either centre or run the full width; small data sits in narrow columns with tiny serif labels left of sans values, and hairline tables are inset to the right-hand third.

sections.description: White screen with a two-line sans heading centred at roughly 6.5vw, tight leading, taking the top third. Directly beneath, two tiny grey captions of two lines each sit side by side, each about 130px wide, centred as a pair. A full-bleed panoramic render starts immediately below and runs off the bottom, so the heading reads as a caption to the picture.

Far left, three label and value pairs at 9px (serif label, sans value) stack in a 150px column. From 34% across, a five-line serif paragraph at about 22px runs to 90% of the width. 120px lower a second row repeats the logic for achievements: a label at far left, then two narrow list columns of awards and publications at 9px with generous gaps between them.

A four-line serif statement at 4.5vw spans the full width, left-aligned with the first line indented about 3% and leading under 1. Below it, pushed into the right-hand 35% of the page, an offices table: a tiny label hangs to its left, and each row holds office type, country and city in grey, an address, and a small arrow, divided by hairlines at 18px row height.

Solid black. A top band of five tiny columns (name, navigation, media, address, hours), each a grey label beside a white list. Then a four-letter abbreviation of the name in white grotesk fills the entire width, letters about 45% of the viewport tall and touching both edges, with a single 8px legal line squeezed beneath.

steal: Set the last word of a sans headline in an upright serif of the same size to give a plain name a signature without any graphic device.
Alternate statement voices down the page: a centred grotesk heading, then a full-width left-aligned serif paragraph at display size with a first-line indent.
Close with an abbreviation of the name scaled until it touches both edges of a black footer, with all practical links shrunk to 9px above it.
references.media: One photoreal render covers the whole first screen with only the title docked bottom-left and no scrim. Below: a full-bleed 2:1 band under a centred headline, overscanned 32px per side for parallax, a staggered two-column scatter of landscape and portrait frames at uneven offsets, hand sketches drawn into the white page between statements, and a ring of small rotated square team photographs round a centred headline on black; 27 images and a fixed WebGL layer, no video.
references.motion: A white preloader with a progress line along the top and a counter stalled near 60 for 2.5s; by 4.5s the hero is in and the title rises out of a mask line by line. Lenis over the fixed WebGL layer: sketches build stroke by stroke on a scrub, the ground flips white to black over 0.3s at the values chapter, paragraph lines rise over 0.5s, and team photographs spiral in and settle into a ring; one ease for everything, cubic-bezier(.17,.84,.44,1), 34 uses.

references.name: Odyssée
references.idea: A medical-aesthetics clinic presented like a skincare editorial: soft-lit close-ups of skin and slow muted loops carry the page, a thin navy serif voice argues for method over myth, and the page ends on a rolling pearl engraved with the wordmark, one polished object that stands for the result.
references.hero: A full-bleed muted video portrait (a woman resting her chin on her hands in pale grey-blue studio light) fills the screen, followed at once by a second full-bleed close-up of lips and jaw. No headline: a single 42px strip crosses the exact vertical middle in white, the serif wordmark at x=20, an 18px serif tagline about medical aesthetics at column 3 (x≈255), and four tiny tracked caps links on the right ending in the booking link, which all but vanishes against the pale picture. The strip holds while both pictures pass under it, then becomes a sticky 42px header. The entrance is a flat warm grey veil carrying only the wordmark and tagline, lifting over about 2.5s.
references.type: Two families. psTimes, a condensed Times-style serif at weight 350, for statements at 48px (3.3vw) and 32px and for titles and the tagline at 18px, sentence case, leading about 1.0-1.05, every statement with a first-line indent of one column. Basel Grotesk at 430 for 14px body and 12px lightly tracked uppercase labels and links; the house version sets those in sentence case at 16px. Fixed px sizes per breakpoint, no clamp().
references.colour: #fffcf8 #1e305e #ffffff #28292a — A warm cream ground behind nearly everything, one deep navy for 88% of the text, the progress rule and a duotone on secondary pictures, white only over photographs. A single small red dot on a live clock is the only accent; the photographs supply skin tones, pale grey-blue studio grounds and a champagne pearl.
references.imagery: Soft, even studio light on pale grey-blue backgrounds, natural skin with no retouching gloss, tight crops (lips, eye, nostril, knees) and one face turned 90 degrees for tension; slow, nearly still muted loops of skin, serum drops and bubbles used as living photographs; a navy duotone on two link cards. Square corners and cover crops everywhere.
references.layout: 20px outer margins on a 12-column grid (columns about 117px). Text has two anchors: column 3 (x≈255) for statements, body and labels, and the exact centre line for right-half paragraphs and cards. Media is always full-bleed, an exact half (720/720) or flush tiles with no gutter. Cream gaps of 232-552px separate sections, roughly one idea per screen; the closing contacts huddle in the left half.

sections.description: A 48px light serif statement on three lines from column 3 to the right margin with a one-column first-line indent, a small 108x161 double-portrait thumbnail docked at the left margin, then 14px body in a narrow column and a booking link.

Pinned for four steps: a counter, a label and a 1400px rule whose navy fill grows a quarter per step, over four 350x263 muted 5s video tiles flush edge to edge; the active tile at full strength, the other three washed to about 10%, each with an 18px serif title beneath.

Split on the centre line: a tall 672x1233 muted skin close-up holds the right half while scrolling, a small 233x291 clip of a serum drop sits just left of centre with a short caption, and a three-word 48px serif headline arrives at x=20 at mid-height.

Contact rows, an opening-hours table where only today is in full navy, and a live local clock with a pulsing dot; then the page lifts away to reveal a fixed full-bleed 9s loop of a pearl rolling on a pale grey surface with the wordmark engraved round it.

steal: Make video behave like photographs: muted, looping, with posters, 5-29s of nearly still subjects started by script when they come into view, square corners and cover crops everywhere.

Give every serif statement a first-line indent of exactly one grid column and anchor the block at column 3 with 20px outer margins, so the indent reads as a deliberate grid step; use the exact centre line as the second anchor for half-width pictures and right-half paragraphs.

End on real local detail (an hours table that marks today, a live local clock), then reveal a fixed full-bleed brand object as the last screen. The site's tiny white caps nav over pale skin all but disappears; the house version is a plain bar with the booking action as a real button.
references.media: Video is the main medium: a 27s portrait loop and a second close-up fill the first screen, then four 5s tiles flush edge to edge, a 720/720 diptych, a tall half-width clip held while scrolling, a full-bleed band that fades up from cream, two navy duotone cards, and a fixed pearl loop revealed under the footer. Nine images and eight muted, looping videos with posters, started by script; no canvas.
references.motion: No preloader: a warm grey veil lifts off the hero video over about 2.5-3s with the type already in place. Under Lenis the features section pins for four steps, cross-fading tiles over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) as the navy rule grows, images fade over 0.5s cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1), underlines grow by background-size over .4s expo-out and the page lifts off a fixed bottom layer to reveal the pearl, but content is opacity-gated, so mid-scroll frames show empty cream, and there is no reduced-motion rule.
